name: openUtilityTab
description: Show one of the guest's own pages in this Nexus window as a utility tab: a tab tagged with `key`, owned by no chat session and absent from every session's tab tally. When a tab with that key already exists it is foregrounded and returned as is (not re-navigated); otherwise a new foreground tab loads `url`. Returns { tabId, created }. http/https only.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The utility tab's name: 1-32 characters of a-z, 0-9 and hyphen. One tab per key per window.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: The page a NEW tab loads; ignored when the key's tab already exists.
